costScope: totalCost covers the frozen protocol; totalResearchCost adds its recorded validation pilot. Earlier pilots and engineering checks are retained separately, excluded from these costs, and were not used as historical training data.

analysisMethod.name: Crossed row and seed-block percentile bootstrap
analysisMethod.columns: Shared final simulation seeds, sampled once per bootstrap draw and reused across its rows
analysisMethod.pairedContrasts: Subtract methods within the same optimizer and simulation-seed block before resampling.

uncertainty: With three optimizer repetitions and five simulation seed blocks, intervals are descriptive and do not establish statistical significance. Results are conditional on the shared selection-seed block.
scope: Two unseen demand/fleet conditions on the same map. Cross-map reoptimization, if enabled, is a separate test. Three optimizer repetitions support descriptive uncertainty, not strong significance claims.

protocol.initialization: Same four legal mappings as every primary method; all are evaluated and charged
protocol.emitter: Execute pinned original ask/sample_k; one mutation size per batch; mutate the raw archive genotype
protocol.archive: One-cell elitist archive; strict improvement and first maximum in batch wins ties, as pyribs 0.5.0
protocol.repair: Same minimum Hamming objective and quota constraints; deterministic row-major optimal ties replace CPLEX ties
protocol.duplicates: Retain original duplicate proposals and execute every replicate; no cached calls count as evaluations
protocol.differencesFromPaper: Shared initial size 4 and lambda 3, project demand conditions, corrected native runtime, 1500 ticks, parcel objective, two selection seeds and independent final evaluation; no numerical paper reproduction
protocol.greedyInput: Pinned original greedy function uses normalized project demand weights; no stored author mappings
protocol.uncertainty: Crossed bootstrap resamples optimizer rows and shared simulation-seed columns independently; descriptive only
protocol.decisionRule: Supplement added to verify source-level baseline correspondence; no parameter tuning from final outcomes

overallStudyCostScope: Primary frozen protocol, its bound validation pilot, and the separate original reference; engineering checks are excluded.
